instruction: Buy one Codenames Board Game for each of my parents and siblings on Amazon, and have it delivered to their homes. Club purchases for the same place in the same order to save delivery fees.
notes: Delivery 'homes' (distinct relative addresses) are the unit of ordering; each home carries the number of relatives living there via needs-quantity, so one add_product_to_cart(quantity=n, clear_cart_first=true) + place_order per home realizes the 'club purchases for the same place' requirement and keeps only Codenames in every order. Assumed grouping (to be verified from phone.search_contacts home_address values): both parents share one home (quantity 2) and there are two siblings with separate homes (quantity 1 each); add/remove home objects and needs-quantity facts if the contact lookup reveals a different family layout. Homes and the product are domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can state the goal conditions explicitly. phone.show_contact_relationships is used to confirm the exact relationship strings before filtering contacts. Address components are parsed from the contact's home_address string (zip_code as integer); the address name is the recipient relative's full name. Cart state is ignored by the evaluation, so clear_cart_first=true is used instead of a separate clear_cart call; placing an order empties the cart (cart-loaded/cart-has reset).
